title: Closing dedication

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: That should be the name of this interview. You look like you’re getting a little tired?
All right. I think we should dedicate this interview to your mother . . .
. . . the two women, one of whom gave you life, and the other of whom continues to give you life.
Yes, yes. You got it just right.
All right. On that happy note . . .
